name: B10-0476/2025 (ECR) – Renewing the EU-Africa partnership: building common priorities ahead of the Angola Summit
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on renewing the EU-Africa partnership: building common priorities ahead of the Angola Summit
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for a renewed partnership between the EU and African countries, based on equality and mutual respect. It wants the 2025 summit in Angola to focus on practical results: peace and security, investment and jobs, energy and infrastructure, fair trade, and better control of migration. It also asks the EU to work with national plans like Italy's Mattei Plan and to involve church organisations in aid and peace work. This is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament asks the EU to act on these priorities.
- **Who it affects:** EU institutions, member states, African partners, and church groups.
- **What happens next:** The EU prepares goals for the Angola summit in 2025.
